protocol.hypothesis: Confirm the highest qualifying development-CV fixed normal-L/M6 mixture. Refit raw B, normal B and selected normal L independently in six fresh patient plans, three seeds per branch; retain the selected feature layout and all three mixture weights.
protocol.reference_comparators: Fresh M5; fixed .9M5+.1patient-balanced coarseGaussian,shrinkage.1,temperature sqrt256; M6=.25M5+.75normalB.
protocol.confirmation_gate: Mean6fold Macro-F1 strictly higher than EACH of M6/M5/fixedGaussian AND repeated paired patient bootstrap95% Macro-F1 lower endpoint>0 versus EACH. No automatic external testing.
protocol.external_test_policy: Only original1717 trainingimages form fit/stop/outer. Originalvalidation unused for confirmation. External feature rows NaN; no external outcomes or predictions loaded.
protocol.audit: Freeze all6patientplans before anyfit; freeze two distinct normal PCA geometries before each fold nine heads. Independently rebuild54heads,18large fulltask witnesses,all stopping/outer predictions,12normalspaces,18Gaussian moments and the nested three-component candidate mixture.
